 Should Barcelona sign Pedro Porro?
 Time to talk the Spanish full-back
 by Renato Gonçalves Nov 12, 2026, 5:00 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Photo by Robbie Jay Barratt - AMA/Getty Images Getty Images Renato Gonçalves Renato Goncalves is the deputy manager of Barca Blaugranes and has been writing for the site since all the way back in 2014. He’s a massive sports fan and has been crazy about Barcelona ever since Rivaldo scored that bicycle kick in 2001. Spain and Tottenham Hotspur’s Pedro Porro is back in the Barcelona news this week as the full-back spoke about the reported interest from the Blaugrana as we approach the January transfer window.
 Porro had a very good World Cup for Spain and is seen as a “dream signing” by president Joan Laporta, who thinks he’d be the perfect addition at right-back given his familiarity with Lamine Yamal in the Spain setup.
 The 27-year-old was happy to hear about Barça’s interest and Laporta’s admiration, and has been linked with Barça for quite some time now.
 Hansi Flick hasn’t found the perfect answer at right-back this season yet, with Eric Garcia, Jules Kounde, Xavi Espart, Brian Fariñas and even Frenkie de Jong being used in the role, and bringing in a high-level specialist at the position such as Porro certainly sounds like an interesting prospect.
 So today’s Barca Blaugranes Question of the Day is:
 Should Barcelona sign Pedro Porro?
